source.title: Rajasthan High Court on Employer-Employee Relationship Under the Workmen’s Compensation Act
source.description:
Can a family receive employee compensation without proving that the deceased actually worked there?

The Rajasthan High Court held that the answer is no.

In this case, there were no salary records, appointment letters, attendance records, or wage slips to establish an employer-employee relationship. The Court also clarified that taking an injured person to the hospital is an act of humanity and by itself, does not prove employment.

Since the employer-employee relationship was not established, the Court set aside the compensation award.

pack.topic: Coimbatore Land Documentation: Legal Proof vs Verbal Promises
pack.source_script_insight: Humanitarian actions or oral witness claims do not establish a legal relationship or statutory rights; primary documentary evidence is strictly mandatory.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Coimbatore property buyers often rely on seller goodwill, key handover, or physical access in areas like Saravanampatti or Thudiyalur without verifying registered documentary proof (Patta, EC, Parent Deeds).

- Scene 6 (7.0s - 8.5s): Live-action footage of a land surveyor stretching a yellow measuring tape along a tar road curb in a Coimbatore layout site (e.g., Saravanampatti context). Camera: Smooth panning right. Text overlay: 'ஆவணச் சரிபார்ப்பு'. VO: 'ஆவணங்களை மட்டும் நம்புங்கள்!'

CONTINUITY & STYLE RULES:
- Maintain natural Tamil Nadu daylight, realistic red soil color grading, authentic paper textures, and actual Coimbatore site environment elements (EB poles, coconut trees, tar roads).
- No presenter direct-to-camera speaking. No floating houses or magical CGI elements.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
Do not include cartoons, 2D animations, glossy 3D renders, unreal smooth plastic surfaces, white-background explainer videos, fake futuristic city, floating icons, non-Tamil documents, or generic foreign locations. Avoid full-screen solid logo end cards; keep real visual scene in background for Scene 7.
pack.title_english: Coimbatore Property Alert: Verbal Promises Don't Equal Legal Rights
pack.caption_english:
Thinking land access or a seller's friendly word means you own the plot? In legal property transactions across Coimbatore—whether in Saravanampatti, Kovaipudur, or Thudiyalur—verbal assurances hold zero legal standing.

Just as legal rights require formal proof, your land ownership depends strictly on verified primary documents like Patta, Encumbrance Certificate (EC), and Parent Deeds. Good faith gestures can never replace statutory paper records.

Before making any advance payment, verify your documents with OliveTree SafeBuy to protect your hard-earned property investments in Coimbatore.
